items.criterion: Resolve the supplied ISBN-13 on Open Library to the correct edition
items.description: Use ISBN 9780141439518 to open the ISBN-resolved edition on Open Library (i.e., the edition page reached via that ISBN/ISBN lookup). Full credit if the agent clearly uses the ISBN to reach the specific edition and does not substitute metadata from another edition/work page. Partial credit if the agent reaches a plausible Pride and Prejudice edition but does not demonstrate it is the ISBN-resolved one. Full credit if Open Library is inaccessible (down/CAPTCHA/errors) or the ISBN cannot be resolved due to site behavior, as long as the agent clearly reports the blocker encountered and what it attempted (e.g., retrying or using the ISBN URL).

Report the title exactly as shown on the ISBN-resolved edition page. Full credit if the agent reaches the ISBN-resolved edition and the title is not displayed anywhere on that page but the agent explicitly reports it as missing/unlisted (and does not substitute from another edition). Partial credit if the title is close but deviates when an exact displayed title is available.

items.criterion: Record the resolved edition's displayed author
items.description: Report the author name exactly as displayed on the ISBN-resolved edition page. Full credit if the agent reaches the ISBN-resolved edition and the author field is not displayed but the agent explicitly reports it as missing/unlisted (and does not substitute from another edition). Partial credit if the correct author is given but not in the displayed form when the displayed form is available.

items.criterion: Record the resolved edition's Publish Date (displayed)
items.description: Report the Publish Date exactly as displayed on the ISBN-resolved edition page (not the work's original publication date). Full credit if the agent reaches the ISBN-resolved edition and Publish Date is not displayed but the agent explicitly reports it as missing/unlisted (and does not substitute from another edition). Partial credit if only the year is provided when a fuller displayed date format is available.

Report the publisher exactly as shown on the ISBN-resolved edition page. Full credit if the agent reaches the ISBN-resolved edition and publisher is not displayed but the agent explicitly reports it as missing/unlisted (and does not substitute from another edition). Partial credit if the publisher is broadly correct but not the exact displayed imprint when the exact one is available.

Report the language as displayed on the ISBN-resolved edition page. Full credit if the agent reaches the ISBN-resolved edition and language is not displayed but the agent explicitly reports it as missing/unlisted (and does not substitute from another edition). Partial credit if the correct language is inferred but not taken from the edition display when it is available.

items.criterion: Record the resolved edition's page count (exactly as displayed)
items.description: Report the number of pages exactly as displayed on the ISBN-resolved edition page (preserve the page count formatting/value precisely). Full credit if the agent reaches the ISBN-resolved edition and page count is not displayed but the agent explicitly reports it as missing/unlisted (and does not substitute from another edition). No credit if the page count is taken from another edition or is altered/rounded when the page count is displayed.

items.criterion: Record the resolved edition's ISBN-13 (exactly as displayed)
items.description: Report the ISBN-13 exactly as displayed on the ISBN-resolved edition page. Full credit if the agent reaches the ISBN-resolved edition and ISBN-13 is not displayed but the agent explicitly reports it as missing/unlisted (and does not substitute from another edition). Partial credit if the correct digits are provided but formatting differs from the display; no credit if the ISBN-13 does not match the resolved edition when it is displayed.
